name: SubTalk glossary and translation policy
translation_rules: Translate the actual spoken content, not the prepared script by default.
Use Bible book canonical Turkish names from bible_books.json, but allow recognition aliases for older editions.
Apply terms marked always sparingly; do not force them into sentences unless their referent appears.
Use context to distinguish an older brother (ağabey) from a JW brother (birader), and an older sister (abla) from a JW sister (hemşire).
Never replace a human father (baba) with God (Tanrı) or Yehova.
Never replace the divine name Yehova with a generic title.
Preserve negation, quantity, numbers, speaker commitments, and names.
Do not output a full Bible verse merely because the speaker mentions the reference.
For Bible readings, use only translated spoken content unless a separately approved, fully matched excerpt is configured.
If chapter, verse, or book is uncertain, do not create a precise reference; emit source-confirmed content only.
Do not hallucinate speech from silence, music, or Japanese interpretation duplicates.
Any uncertain language or garbled ASR text must be withheld or resolved from the Japanese interpretation when appropriate.
Do not silently use review_required glossary terms as authoritative JW-specific terms until a human Turkish reviewer signs off.

bible_ref_handling.allowed_only_if: Book/chapter/verse are explicitly supported by audio, or explicitly verified matching prepared passage AND configured for approval.
bible_ref_handling.never_infer: Missing book, chapter, verse, or full quotation from topic or script alone.

reference_examples.mn: Эфэс тавдугаар бүлэг гучин гуравдугаар зүйл

readiness.tr_attested_terms: Turkish wording appears in cited JW.org sources; verify contextual applicability.
readiness.review_required_terms: Human Turkish-speaking reviewer recommended before live use.
